pins.name: VCC
pins.notes: Red wire. Needs 5 to 24 V: use VIN (5 V)

pins.name: A
pins.notes: Green wire. NPN open collector: use INPUT_PULLUP or 4.7 kΩ to 3V3, never to VCC

pins.name: B
pins.notes: White wire. NPN open collector: use INPUT_PULLUP or 4.7 kΩ to 3V3, never to VCC

pins.name: SHIELD
pins.notes: Bare wire. Leave unconnected or tie to GND
